slot_policy: Calendar-relative, determined independently of outcomes. A completed 1H bar must end strictly before the timestamp. Overlapping/duplicate timestamps are rejected for a cash session. T-30 is retained to test hourly-information redundancy.
labels: Retrospective only: next first-minute native open / previous close. Fixed slot-specific resolution scales and residual bands use the first 15 pre-OOS cash sessions only; no later outcome is used to select parameters.
guard: Reject any split ending beyond 2026-08-14T20:00:00Z before archive access; no final-OOS option
